_comment: OMN-18750 prose-sink backtick command-substitution policy. A backtick pair inside a double-quoted shell string is command substitution, so a note that quotes a command in markdown backticks EXECUTES it. This policy declares what counts as a prose sink: a destination whose content is text a human will read, where a backtick substitution is never intended. Vocabulary lives here rather than in the decision core so a new sink can be declared without editing code.
_comment_flags: Text-bearing option names. The VALUE of one of these is prose by construction. --body-file and --description-file are deliberately absent: they name a file, not text.
_comment_suffixes: Write targets whose content is prose. Matched case-insensitively against the redirect or tee target's basename.
_comment_stems: Basename fragments that mark a prose surface whatever its extension: the fleet ledger, lane checkpoints, handoffs and changelogs.
_comment_tee: Programs that write their stdin to a named file. tee's target is a redirect by another name.
